issues: 选项名是 "Option one plan / Option three long name" 这类占位，标题 "OPTION GROUP" 是调试字样，读不出在选什么
chip 是平白块 + 极弱阴影，黑 chip 是纯 #0B0B0C 平涂，选中后和其他 chip 没有材质差别
算式行 "18% off · 42.00 → 34.44" 只有数字没有价格语义，原价与现价同权重
收束态黑 chip 在 y≈320、算式行在 y≈700，中间近 300px 空档，整组偏上、构图散
纯色平铺浅灰底，没有光的方向
changes: 选项换成计费周期（Annual billing / Monthly billing / Two-year commitment / Student / Nonprofit rate），标题改 BILLING CYCLE；时间轴与参数表（灰闪 1 帧、反黑 5f linear、回弹 0.04、余项 18%）全部不变
chip 改为 1px 发丝线（0.25 设计 px 内描边，几何宽度不变）+ 顶部内高光 + 两层软阴影；黑 chip 反黑时叠受光上沿渐变，投影随上移离地加深
算式行改价格结算 "18% off · $42.00 → $34.44/mo"：保留逐词加深，原价加深后再划线退为次级灰，现价 700 字重加大一号
整组下移 30 设计 px、算式行从 150 上提到 108，选择态与收束态的视觉重心都落在画面中线附近
背景换柔光渐变 + 轻暗角 + 颗粒，放在 DesignStage 之外，不随 4× 设计缩放变粗
issuesEn: Options are placeholders like "Option one plan / Option three long name" under a debug-style "OPTION GROUP" title, so you can't tell what is being chosen
Chips are flat white with a barely visible shadow and the selected chip is a flat #0B0B0C fill, so the selected state has no material difference
The formula "18% off · 42.00 → 34.44" is bare numbers with no pricing meaning; old and new price carry equal weight
In the end state the black chip sits at y≈320 and the formula at y≈700, leaving a ~300px hole and a top-heavy, scattered layout
Flat light-grey fill with no sense of light direction
changesEn: Options are billing choices (Annual billing / Monthly billing / Two-year commitment / Student / Nonprofit rate) under BILLING CYCLE; the timeline and parameter table (1-frame grey flash, 5f linear blackout, 0.04 bounce, others to 18%) are untouched
Chips get a 1px hairline (0.25 design-px inset stroke, same geometry), top inner highlight and two-layer soft shadow; the black chip adds a lit top-edge gradient and a shadow that deepens as it lifts
Formula reads as checkout math "18% off · $42.00 → $34.44/mo": word-by-word darkening kept, the old price is struck through and greys out after darkening, the new price is 700 weight and one size up
Whole group shifted down 30 design px and the formula raised from 150 to 108, so both the choice state and the end state center on the frame
Soft-lit gradient background with light vignette and grain, rendered outside DesignStage so it doesn't get coarser under the 4× design scale
